description: Retrieves a list of all teams that the authenticated user has access to within the specified Sentry organization.

inputSchema.description: Lists all teams a user has access to within a specific Sentry organization.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (numeric ID like '4508539392294912') or URL-friendly slug (like 'my-organization') of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: ListOrganizationUserTeamsRequest

name: list_organization_user_teams

Avatar.description: Letter avatar representation for the team.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the avatar image, or null if not available.
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

avatarUuid.description: UUID of the avatar, or null if not set.
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid

Avatar.title: Avatar

ListOrganizationUserTeamsResponse.description: Array of teams the user has access to within the organization.
ListOrganizationUserTeamsResponse.title: ListOrganizationUserTeamsResponse

TeamMember.description: Details of a team within the organization.

access.description: Array of permission scopes granted by the team role (e.g., team:read, project:read, event:read).
access.title: Access

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the team was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

externalTeams.description: List of external team integrations (optional, may not be included in all responses).
externalTeams.title: External Teams

flags.description: Feature flags associated with the team (e.g., idp:provisioned).
flags.title: Flags

hasAccess.description: Whether the user has access to this team.
hasAccess.title: Has Access

isMember.description: Whether the current user is a member of this team.
isMember.title: Is Member

isPending.description: Whether the user's membership or access request is pending.
isPending.title: Is Pending

memberCount.description: Total number of active members in the team.
memberCount.title: Member Count

organization.description: Parent organization details (optional, may not be included in all responses).
organization.title: Organization

projects.description: List of projects associated with the team (optional, may not be included in all responses).
projects.title: Projects

teamRole.description: The user's role within the team, or null if the user is not a member.
teamRole.title: Team Role

TeamMember.title: TeamMember
